claims.claim: All 9 frozen SKUs were retained; frozen head_status_verified is true for 6 and false for 3; exact_variant_verified is true for all 9.
claims.counterevidence: None observed; frozen metadata preserved without upgrade.

claims.claim: Post-freeze ordinary public/model-level prices were directly observable for C04-S03 CNY2049, C05-S02 CNY599, C05-S03 CNY3499, C06-S01 CNY249, and C06-S03 CNY289; C06-S02 had a CNY499 MSRP/reference price.
claims.counterevidence: Some prices are model-level rather than color-specific checkout prices; logged-in/coupon/final-to-hand prices were not inferred.

claims.claim: Two directly opened overseas listings support A-bucket item-price observations: Samsung MZ-V9S2T0BW at USD497.22 and Xiaomi BE6500 at USD147.51; neither establishes complete delivered cost to ZIP10001.
claims.counterevidence: Destination-specific delivery/import charges were not fully exposed.

claims.claim: No B-bucket same-OEM/rebrand match was established.
claims.counterevidence: Visual/spec similarity was intentionally not treated as OEM proof.

claims.claim: Several cheaper-looking overseas pages were downgraded to C or rejected because region, bundle, capacity, color, or exact variant did not match the frozen SKU.
claims.counterevidence: A later exact-region/exact-bundle source could change individual classifications.

claims.claim: As of 2026-10-06 the former general USD800 de minimis treatment cannot be assumed for these imports; current mode-specific entry requirements must be considered.
claims.counterevidence: Specific entry treatment still depends on mode and shipment facts.

claims.claim: A Section 301 determination requires the applicable HTS classification; no fixed rate was imputed for unclassified SKUs.
claims.counterevidence: A broker/CBP classification could later establish SKU-specific rates.

claims.claim: Community evidence was used only for compatibility/experience signals, not for transaction price, OEM identity, or market-share inference.

data_gaps: No SKU has all mandatory landed-cost components observed.
No live standalone, consolidated-marginal, 1000-independent-order business, or true physical-bulk freight quote was obtained.
Actual/volumetric weights and packaging dimensions were not consistently observable.
SKU-specific auditable HTS classifications were not established; therefore MFN, Section 301 and other duty rates remain null rather than guessed.
Current FY2027 entry/clearance mandatory charges were not imputed from earlier fiscal-year schedules.
No common observed FX rate was applied because no complete landed calculation could be formed.
US state/local sales or use tax is intentionally excluded from the comparison endpoint.
C04-S01, C04-S02 and C05-S01 current domestic transaction prices remain unverified.
C06-S02 has an MSRP/reference price but no verified ordinary transaction price.
All source attestations in this batch await coordinator review.
